checks.engine_answer: Shelter sets the country's Shelter flag to 1 for the rest of the round. Cleanup counts it down to 0, so it never protects in next round's adversary turn. While it is up, destroy_piece refuses every destruction in that country, war included: a war strike on a factory in a sheltered country fails (the troop is spent), so a node on that factory survives too. The war rule that 'no Shelter saves that node' only matters when the factory is actually destroyed, and that can't happen in a sheltered country. Only the stage-I last-node check runs inside lose_node.
